title: RKB extraction PMI — minimal first-run result (NOT RUN)
description: Schema for future append-only question-only blind results, NOT a runner or stored result. Frozen batch/source/arm/variant/repeat/attempt identity and original evidence oracle remain in the immutable run manifest and native tool logs; the row carries only first-run essentials. No gold or raw private text in this file.

case_id.description: The case ID from the immutable source-grounded registry; no gold is sent with the question.

question.description: Exact natural question variant shown to the blinded runner; source scope/variant are pinned outside the row.

text_ref.description: Opaque link to actual observed answer, persisted Variant.body, or facts_only. Null if none; no freshly invented narrative.

evidence_refs.description: Native authorised accepted source/revision/page/passage references actually returned. Never invent IDs or replace missing imported evidence with public URLs.

hit_at_k.description: Evidence Hit@5 and Hit@10 against independent original-based gold. Null until adjudicated or unavailable; null never means false.

latency_ms.description: Per attempt end-to-end clocks including client/tool waits and model generation for user_to_answer, null if not observed. Backend/public stage timings remain in native telemetry, not this first-run row.

verdict.description: Keep execution and later original-grounded rubric verdict distinct. Individual completed execution != full-batch EXECUTION_COMPLETE; review requires all sources/arms/repeats frozen, two independent adjudicators, then ADJUDICATION_COMPLETE.
